themes.name: casper
themes.notes: Ghost names an uploaded theme after the uploaded zip file, and refuses to override its bundled default theme 'casper' (HTTP 422). The archive is therefore installed as casper-5.12.5.

themes.name: source
themes.notes: Second official Ghost theme, used by instances/b to prove the two-theme gate from the same template. The archive has no symlink entries; apply.sh still repacks every theme with links dereferenced.
